axes.description: Who or what produced an observation. Always explicit; absence never means agent.

terms.description: A model-driven reviewer produced the observation.
A non-model tool or analyzer produced the observation.
A human reviewer produced the observation.
The observation was migrated from a legacy contract.
The producer could not be determined from available context.

axes.description: Coverage of the evidence backing an observation. Describes coverage only; it is not a pass or block.

terms.description: All expected evidence was collected.
Some expected evidence was collected.
No expected evidence was collected.

axes.description: What the evidence establishes for a review or an aspect.

terms.description: The evidence supports a positive assessment.
The evidence supports a qualified, non-blocking assessment.
The evidence supports a negative assessment.
The evidence does not support a definitive assessment.
The aspect does not apply to this subject.
The aspect was not evaluated.

axes.description: Direction of a before/after comparison. Used only for such comparisons.

terms.description: The comparison shows improvement.
The comparison shows regression.
The comparison shows both improvement and regression.
The comparison shows no meaningful difference.
No comparable prior observation exists.
The comparison cannot be evaluated from available evidence.

axes.description: An optional policy output with a required policyRef. Never supplied by a raw finding.

terms.description: Policy permits the change or subject to proceed.
Policy flags the change or subject without blocking it.
Policy prevents the change or subject from proceeding.
Policy defers the disposition to a later or human decision.

axes.description: Retains current ordering and meaning; scoring weights stay in policy.

terms.description: The most severe classification.
A high-severity classification.
A medium-severity classification.
A low-severity classification.
An informational classification with no severity implication.

axes.description: Lives in lifecycle events, not observations.

terms.description: The issue is unresolved and awaiting action.
The issue is knowingly accepted.
The issue is waived by policy or reviewer decision.
The issue does not represent a real defect.
The issue has been fixed.

axes.description: Each item has a locator or artifact reference, summary, and digest when content is available.

terms.description: Evidence located in source code.
Evidence from a test execution result.
Evidence from a runtime measurement.
Evidence from a deterministic tool or scanner result.
Evidence referencing a stored artifact.
Evidence referencing a document.
Evidence attested by a human reviewer.
